"# Tasks: Health App Redesign & Upgrades

## Dependencies
- **Sequential Toast Queue** (US1) is required before desktop notification preview triggers.
- **WAV Sound Synthesis** (US3) is required before sound test triggers.
- **Modern Layout Cards** (US4) is required before building the Preview Hub (US5).

## Parallel Opportunities
- **US1** (Sequential Queue) and **US2** (Sleep/Wake detection) can be developed in parallel since they touch different parts of `toast_utils.py` and the main scheduler loops.
- **US3** (Sound Customization assets) can be worked on concurrently with the UI redesign.

---

## Phase 1: Setup & Sound Assets

- [ ] T001 Verify or create sound assets directory `HealthApp/resources/sounds/`
- [ ] T002 Implement a programmatic sound synthesizer helper in `HealthApp/health_app.py` to generate 10 clean, sci-fi/tech WAV sound effects if not already present

## Phase 2: Core Logic Upgrades (Queue & Sleep Resume)

- [ ] T003 [P] Implement thread-safe sequential `ToastQueue` class with 1.5s delay inside `toast_utils.py`
- [ ] T004 [P] Hook `BaseToast.show()` inside `toast_utils.py` and `HealthApp/health_app.py` into the `ToastQueue` so all notifications queue up sequentially
- [ ] T005 [P] Implement loop time delta tracking (`time.time() - last_loop > 10.0`) in scheduler loops in `HealthApp/health_app.py` to reset warning states and break timers upon system wake-from-sleep

## Phase 3: Settings UI Cyberpunk Redesign
